mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in nonfarm payrolls signal labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 1800 units), rising residential sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1800 and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate consistently indicates labor market tightening that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP and housing starts indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate earnings and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 and HOUST both rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
